title: Site: theme & hobby images
source: Product spec L4 (Scaffolding Removal + R.C.T.F. theme comparison)
drivingQuestion: How can I critically partner with Artificial Intelligence to build a digital portfolio that authentically represents who I am to the world?

hints.structure: Use the formula: Subject:, Style:, Framing:, Lighting:.
hints.vocab: Try using today's visual words in your prompt: concept art, close-up, volumetric lighting, background, section, or layout.
hints.diff: You are the Operator! Please change at least one visual detail (Subject / Style / Framing / Lighting) in your next prompt.
hints.empty: Write a prompt - the text instructions you give to the image AI.
hints.reasonRequired: Please explain in English why you want to change this image before generating a new one.
hints.reasonShort: Your reason needs at least 3 words. Tell the AI what is wrong with the image.
hints.publish: This image will go on your website. You can publish it now or keep improving it - you have up to 6 attempts total.
hints.noMore: No attempts left. Publish a version from your history.
hints.themeStructure: Use the formula with all four labels: Role: ... Context: ... Task: ... Format: ...
hints.themeContext: Describe what your website is about in the Context line (at least 3 words).
hints.themeMood: Use a mood word in Format, for example warm, calm, natural, bold, energetic or mysterious.
hints.themeDiff: Change your prompt - try a different mood in the Format line to get a second option.
hints.themeSame: Try a different mood - you got the same theme twice. Change the Format line.
hints.chooseNeeded: Choose Theme 1 or Theme 2 to compare before publishing.
hints.justifyShort: Please write a full, meaningful sentence in English to justify your design choice as an Operator.
hints.justifyGrammar: Compare your two theme options - try using words like 'brighter', 'calmer', or 'the boldest' to explain your choice!
hints.justifyVocab: Great grammar! Now, connect it to your website design. Use at least one design word from today's bank: theme, palette, contrast, font, bold, or soft.
